svg.text: Terrain authoring — 3 / 4: single features and the area scatter (DESIGN_Terrain_Authoring.md §2, §7, §8, §11 job ③)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
Hedge — click to add a point
deck + ramps, joined to both banks
one entity — an area + a recipe +
a seed; Unpack makes it single items
① A LINE feature (wall, fence, hedge): the existing point-sequence tool, then its kind and height — becomes WorldWall segments by material (§2).
② A BRIDGE: placed across water, it measures the span and joins both banks; a deck + ramps (a walkable) and a road edge — a chokepoint, and destructible (§8).
③ The AREA SCATTER: draw an area, pick Street clutter / Undergrowth / Rubble, a density — ONE entity (an area, a recipe, a seed), re-rollable (§11 job ③).
single items — or Scatter in an area… to place many at once
The single-feature groups: Buildings (templates), Vegetation (wood area, lone tree, bush), Walls & fences, Clutter, Water & bridges.
Each clutter item is a small box of a material (the obstacle bake's own shape, §7) — the material says what it does to bullets and sight.
The glyph tiles stand in for pictures: each item's thumbnail will be a render of its model, like every other Add Entity tile.
